metric: AN-05: strong = share of pixels whose largest RGB channel differs by more than 64 after a 3x3 box blur; mean = mean largest RGB channel difference (0-255). Compared over the whole capture: the WebView from its top (the header bar with the search field) to the tab bar's top, 393x715 pt at scale 3. Each case passes within its value plus `margin`.

reasons.favorites: The header bar (field, placeholder, 편집), one row: text and image rasterization only; every box is at the captured position (theRowsAreWhereTheCordovaPagePutThem).
reasons.list: As favorites with three rows and London's filled bell.
reasons.edit: The current position's row with the location glyph and the switch (Ionic's handle shadow drawn by SwiftUI), and ⊗ in Ionicons with WebKit's synthetic bold, which CoreText thickens differently at the glyph's edges.
reasons.search: The typed word, 취소, 현재위치로 지역찾기, ten town rows and the divider: text rasterization.
reasons.location: The found row and Google's logo (the bundled PNG scaled to 144 pt).
reasons.measured-adjustments: Measured in the first renders and applied in PlacesMetrics: the input's text 24.5 pt into the field, the bell and ⊗ 2/3 pt higher than their line box, 현재위치로 지역찾기's line 2 2/3 pt under the button's top, the name cell 40 % of the content without rounding.
reasons.en-US: The English system's WebView drew the Korean place names with Apple SD Gothic Neo; the render takes the Korean fallback (cssFallbackLanguage ko).
reasons.headroom: Each case is its local measurement (`measured`, Xcode 27.2, iOS 26.5 simulator) times 1.5 plus 0.0005 for strong and times 1.2 plus 0.2 for mean, rounded up, plus `margin`, as start-tolerances.json: CI renders with Xcode 26.6.
